description: Ask whether a price makes sense for its context, rather than what the price should be. Returns a verdict (fair, too_high, too_low, or unknown), the band it was judged against, a signed deviation from the reference, a confidence, and the evidence behind it. A verdict of "unknown" means the price could not be judged, which is not the same as fair. Pass quote_valid_until from the compute_price result the price came from, and where quote expiry is switched on the answer says quote_expired when that quote is stale. Where paid verdicts are switched on, a caller with no key can pay for one verdict with x402: pass payment, a signed payment for the price and terms listed under payments.x402.verify_price in /.well-known/agents.json; a verdict of unknown is not charged. Where buyers' spend limits are switched on and metadata.category names a category, the evidence includes buyer_budget: what buyers' own spend checks allowed for it (buyer_envelope), reported and never counted in the verdict.

buyer_agent.description: Optional. The buying agent, e.g. chatgpt. A label recorded with the quote only.

buyer_type.description: Optional. Who the price is for: an AI agent or a person. Recorded with the quote only.

channel.description: Optional. The sales channel, e.g. an agent marketplace. With a rate saved by set_channel_rates, the price covers the channel's cut.

currency.description: Three-letter ISO currency code, e.g. USD. Defaults to USD.

current_price.description: Optional incumbent price. Not required: asking whether a price is sensible does not presuppose an existing one.

max_price.description: Optional hard ceiling. Binding: a verdict will never relax it.

min_price.description: Optional hard floor. Binding: a verdict will never relax it.

outcome_terms.description: Optional, for a price charged per outcome: when the outcome counts as failed and what is owed then. The result echoes the terms normalised, with complete false until success_definition, resolve_by and on_timeout are all set.

on_timeout.description: What is owed when the deadline passes without success.

resolve_by.description: The deadline: an ISO 8601 duration from the quote (P30D, PT48H) or an RFC 3339 time. After it, with no success, the outcome has failed.

success_definition.description: What the buyer must see for the outcome to count.

timeout_share.description: With on_timeout "partial": the fraction of the price owed, e.g. 0.3 for 30%.

payment.description: Optional. The signed x402 payment, base64, as sent in an X-PAYMENT or PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header; or, where the answer offers MPP tempo, the whole Payment-Authorization value ("Payment " and the credential). Omit it to read what the call costs and how to pay; nothing is charged until you send it.

product_id.description: Optional identifier of what is being priced.

product_type.description: Optional category of what is being priced.

proposed_price.description: The price to judge. This is the subject of the call.

quote_valid_until.description: Optional. The valid_until of the compute_price result this price came from (RFC 3339). Where quote expiry is switched on, a time already past is answered with quote_expired: true.

name: verify_price
